metadata.description: Sample rules for testing import validation and dry-run functionality
metadata.notes: These are fake/test rules only. Do not import to production.

rules.title: Eligibility Requirements
rules.body: All competitors must hold a valid NHRA competition license appropriate for their class. Licenses must be presented at technical inspection.

rules.title: Fire Suppression System Requirements
rules.body: Vehicles in professional categories must be equipped with a minimum 5-pound fire suppression system mounted in the driver's compartment. System must be SFI 17.1 or 17.2 certified.

rules.title: Engine Displacement Verification
rules.body: Engine displacement will be verified by technical inspectors using the formula: Bore² × Stroke × Number of Cylinders × 0.7854. Maximum allowable variance is +0.5%.

rules.title: Breakout Rule
rules.body: In bracket racing classes, running quicker than your dial-in or index results in disqualification unless both competitors run under, in which case the closer to index wins.
rules.change_summary: Standard breakout rule for bracket racing.

rules.title: Window Net Requirements
rules.body: All vehicles must have a window net installed and in operational condition. Net must be SFI 27.1 certified and mounted securely. Quick-release mechanisms must be functional.
rules.change_summary: Proposed update to window net mounting specifications.
